sources.claim: The previously captured official page version listed 28 eligible accumulation assets.

The current home subdomain page lists 31 eligible assets, including XRP and JPYSC; JPY 500–2,000,000 per order; daily/weekly/monthly; daily 10:00 JST, weekly Tuesday 10:00 JST, monthly 28th 10:00 JST; next-business-day start; requires JPY prefunding and does not support automatic bank debit.
A separate SBI VISA Crypto Card BIZ campaign runs October 1 through November 30, 2026 for applications, with card issuance by December 31 and eligible spend through January 5, 2027.
The standard consumer card converts points into crypto automatically; Standard earns 1 point per JPY 200 (0.5%) and Gold 2 points per JPY 200 (1.0%), with BTC/ETH/XRP asset selection.

dca_asset_count_conflict.start_rule: Orders begin at the first scheduled order time on or after the next business day following enrollment.
dca_asset_count_conflict.caveat: Configured plans can be skipped if available JPY or other platform conditions are insufficient; no XRP-specific plan count or execution volume is disclosed.

capital_interpretation: DCA is a customer-funded purchase mechanism but actual XRP fills and execution source are unknown. Card rewards and campaign bonuses are reward distributions, not proof of external XRP purchases or net new capital.
